title: eOX® AIRCRAFT HYDRAULIC FLUID REMOVER (AHFR) – 250L
description: eOx® Aircraft Hydraulic Fluid Remover (AHFR) is non-toxic, non- flammable, non-hazardous liquid specifically designed to remove sticky hydraulic oil deposits, including SKYDROL® from aircraft. AHFR also removes baked-on carbon and corrosion protecting compounds. Works extremely well on exhaust areas and can be used as a spot cleaner.
